# trustproovr

> Testimonial collection + social-proof widget for launch-stage SaaS founders and indie hackers. One script tag collects testimonials at the right moment (behavioral triggers + smart timing), drafts the words from real usage, and renders approved proof in the customer's own brand. Pricing: $12/mo Pro or $199 lifetime, free trial, self-hostable.

## Docs

- [Widget builder](https://trustproovr.lol/app): paste a product URL, get a themed install snippet
- [Pricing](https://trustproovr.lol/pricing): Pro $12/mo or Lifetime $199 — both include everything
- [Sign in / create account](https://trustproovr.lol/login): email or Google OAuth
- [Dashboard](https://trustproovr.lol/dashboard): approve, reject, and manage testimonials

## Guides

- [How-to guides](https://trustproovr.lol/how-to): collecting, asking, timing, video, placement
- [Platform integrations](https://trustproovr.lol/integrations): Shopify, WordPress, Webflow, Wix, Squarespace, Framer, Kajabi, Teachable, Podia, Carrd
- [Alternatives and comparisons](https://trustproovr.lol/alternatives): honest comparisons vs Senja, Testimonial.to, Trustpilot, and more
- [Sitemap](https://trustproovr.lol/sitemap.xml): all public URLs

## Agent API

All endpoints are JSON. Base URL: https://trustproovr.lol

- [Agent signup](https://trustproovr.lol/api/agent/signup): POST { email, password } → access_token
- [Agent signin](https://trustproovr.lol/api/agent/signin): POST { email, password } → access_token
- [Current account and spaces](https://trustproovr.lol/api/agent/me): GET, Bearer auth
- [Create product space](https://trustproovr.lol/api/agent/spaces): POST { url, prompt?, collectVideo? } → space + scanned brand tokens
- [Install snippet](https://trustproovr.lol/api/agent/spaces/demo/snippet): GET /api/agent/spaces/{slug}/snippet → script + wall markup

### Auth

Send `Authorization: Bearer <access_token>` on every call after signup or signin. Tokens are Supabase JWTs (`expires_in` seconds, refresh via `/api/agent/signin`). Human auth is cookie-based at `/login` — agents should use the JSON endpoints only.

### Billing

`GET /api/agent/spaces/{slug}/snippet` returns **402** with `checkoutUrl` until the account has an active Pro plan — send the user through that URL once; verification stamps `plan: pro` and every call succeeds after.

### Snippet options

Query params on the snippet endpoint:

- `format` = `text` | `video-short` | `video-long`
- `trigger` = `sessions:3` (default) | `time:30` | `scroll:50` | `exit` | `event:NAME` | `milestone`
- `smart` = `off` to disable the behavioral classifier
- `style` = card template (`tweet`, `bigquote`, `stats`, `badge`, `avatars`, `bento`, `glass`, `serif`, `polaroid`, `spotlight`, `logocard`, `chat`, `rating`, `minimal`, ...)
- `accent` = hex like `%233554f5`
- `wall` = `hero` | `footer` | `after:SELECTOR` | `before:SELECTOR` | `in:SELECTOR` — auto-places the wall, no div needed

### Runtime hooks on the site

- `trustproovr.track("purchase")` — fire milestone/custom events (works with `event:` triggers)
- `trustproovr.open()` — force the ask open
- `trustproovr.reset()` — clear local state for testing
- `window.TRUSTPROOVR_USER = { name, email, avatarUrl }` — prefill name/avatar on the ask

### Public surfaces

- Shareable collect link: `/s/{slug}` — customers submit without the widget
- Public wall: `/w/{slug}`
- Human dashboard: `/dashboard/{slug}` — approve/reject submissions
